facts.fact: Raxio launched its carrier-neutral Raxio Data Centre at Kampala Industrial and Business Park on 25 May 2021, offering colocation of up to 400 racks and 1.5MW of IT power.
Raxio says its Kampala Raxio Data Centre holds Tier III certification from the Uptime Institute, as of the launch.
